opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning and emailing a plan
opportunities.description: For a given city and dates, gather Wikipedia population, timeanddate weather, a Booking.com hotel, Viator activities, and a restaurant on a reservation site, save a summary note, then draft an email to a friend with the plan.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, co (restaurant reservations), notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article to read the population
Search the city on timeanddate and open its Weather page for temperature
On Booking.com search the city with check-in/check-out dates and guests, open a top hotel and note the price
On Viator search for 1-2 activities in the city and open the results
On the restaurant site search city + cuisine, pick the date, party size, click Find a table, open a restaurant
Create a new note summarizing city, dates, population, temperature, hotel, activities, dinner
Compose an email to the friend with subject and body summarizing the plan, then discard/close
